files.extent: Complete immutable implementation bytes and existing closure excerpts are bound; observations trace variable/flag indexing.
source_observations: GetVarPointer rejects values below VARS_START but indexes regular variables and gSpecialVars without an upper-bound check; malformed high operands can index outside the intended arrays.
GetFlagAddr returns null for flag zero but likewise lacks an upper-bound check for normal/special flag indices; VarGet returns the input unchanged when GetVarPointer returns null.
These are source-level bounds concerns, not a demonstrated exploit or a native malformed-ROM reproduction; actual reachable input constraints remain unresolved.
